title: Admin Login Bypass
impact: This allows someone to log in as an admin without knowing the correct password.
remediation: Use prepared statements to prevent SQL injection and make sure login inputs are handled safely.

title: Reflected XSS in Order Tracking
impact: This allows harmful JavaScript to run when someone opens a link containing the malicious code.
remediation: Validate user input and safely display text to prevent scripts from running.

title: Stored XSS in Customer Feedback
impact: This allows harmful scripts to be saved in customer feedback and run when other users view it.
remediation: Remove unsafe HTML and scripts from feedback before saving or displaying it.
